name: web_search
description: Search the web. Returns titles, URLs, snippets.

name: fetch_url
description: Fetch a URL as clean Markdown via Jina Reader. Pass `query` to extract a specific portion.

query.description: Optional: what to extract from the page.

name: bash
description: Run a bash command in the project directory. Capped at `timeout` seconds (default 30, max 120).

timeout.description: Kill after N seconds. Default 30, max 120.

name: write_file
description: Create or overwrite a file. Prefer edit_code/patch for existing files. Syntax-checked for .sh/.py/.json.

name: read_code
description: Read a file with line numbers. Use this before edit_code/patch — never guess content.

name: search_files
description: grep a pattern across project files. Returns file:line matches.

path.description: Directory or file. Default: project root.

name: list_files
description: List files in a project directory (depth=2, hidden files excluded).

name: todo
description: Per-session task list. Actions: add, list, done, delete, clear.

name: clarify
description: Ask the user a question and stop the turn. Two shapes: (1) plain — pass only `question`, user answers via free text. (2) multi-choice — pass `question` + `options` (array of 2-6 distinct labels), renders as Telegram inline buttons; user taps one (or types `Other: ...`). Use multi-choice when you've identified 2-6 concrete paths and want a fast tap rather than free text — especially before irreversible work or when scoping a request. Don't use it to confirm what the user obviously wants.

question.description: The question to ask. Be specific and concise — under 200 chars works best on mobile.

options.description: Optional. 2-6 distinct option labels (each ≤60 chars). When provided, renders as inline keyboard buttons on Telegram. Make labels self-explanatory — no extra description column. Order from most→least likely. Omit for free-text questions.

name: process
description: Run/manage background shell processes. Actions: run, list, output, kill.

name: session_search
description: Recall past conversations across all sessions. No LLM cost — pure SQLite/FTS5 lookup. Three modes (inferred from args): (1) discovery — pass `query` for top-N matching sessions with snippets + ±window context + first/last bookends. (2) scroll — pass `session_id` + `around_message_id` to get a window centered on that message; re-anchor to page deeper. (3) browse — no args returns recent sessions with previews. Far cheaper and faster than memory_recall for finding *what we discussed before*; use this when the user references a past conversation/topic/decision.

query.description: Discovery mode: search terms. Multi-word AND-matched via FTS5. Omit to browse or scroll.

session_id.description: Filter discovery to one session, OR (with around_message_id) trigger scroll mode.

around_message_id.description: Scroll mode: anchor message id. Combined with session_id, returns ±window messages around it. Get message ids from a prior discovery result.

limit.description: Discovery: max sessions (1-10, default 5). Browse: max sessions (1-50, default 15).

window.description: Discovery: msgs each side of match (0-15, default 5). Scroll: msgs each side of anchor (1-30, default 5).

name: memory
description: Curated MEMORY.md / USER.md notes (injected every turn). Actions: add, replace, remove, read.

target.description: memory=agent notes (3KB cap), user=user profile (2KB cap).

name: image_generate
description: Generate an image via Pollinations. Returns a URL.

name: edit_code
description: Replace old_string with new_string in a file. Tolerates whitespace drift. Match must be unique unless replace_all=true. Returns unified diff.

name: patch
description: Apply a V4A-format multi-file/multi-hunk patch. Validates all hunks before writing any.

patch.description: Full V4A patch text incl. *** Begin Patch / *** End Patch.

name: repo_map
description: File tree + symbols via ripgrep. Use before editing to locate logic.

name: memory_remember
description: Save text to long-term vector memory (LanceDB). Include topic in metadata_json.

name: memory_recall
description: Semantic search over long-term memory. Try 2-3 phrasings if empty.

name: sys_info
description: CPU, memory, disk, uptime stats.

name: read_error_log
description: Recent agent errors for diagnosis.

name: custom_tool_manager
description: Create/list/delete custom tools (saved to tools/custom/, survives Docker rebuilds).

name: skill_manager
description: Manage skills. list / create / bind / unbind (bind attaches to a Telegram topic).

name: skill_install
description: Clone a public skill repo and install to brain/skills/<name>/. Reads SKILL.md for prompt.

name: insights
description: Token + tool usage stats.

name: browser
description: Headless Chromium for JS-heavy pages. Use when fetch_url fails. Actions: navigate, snapshot, click, type, scroll.

name: recap
description: Summarize current session (or specific session) from raw logs. Faster than session_search for current chat.

name: kanban_show
description: Read a kanban task's state and dependencies.

name: kanban_create
description: Create a kanban task.

name: kanban_complete
description: Mark task done with handoff summary.

name: kanban_block
description: Block task pending human input.

name: ast_edit
description: AST-aware Python editor. Cannot produce syntax errors. Actions: validate, list_symbols, get_symbol, replace_func, add_import, rename.

name: last_session
description: Instant recall of recent session recaps (~0.1s, no embeddings). Use when user asks about past sessions.

name: delegate
description: Delegate to a sub-agent (Claude Code / Codex / self). sync blocks; async returns a session name — poll with mode=check. For async always pass notify_session+notify_msg_id so the watcher sends Telegram progress.

session.description: tmux session name. Required for check/kill.

notify_session.description: AMA session_id for async progress notifications.

name: scheduler
description: Schedule recurring tasks. Actions: add (create), list (show all for this chat), remove (delete by id), pause, resume. For add: requires `prompt` + `every` (e.g. '12h', '30m', '1d'). Optional model/provider/skill override pins the task to a specific (e.g. cheap) backend instead of the default. When the interval elapses, cron spawns a fresh agent run (independent of any active chat) which delivers the result to the original Telegram chat tagged [SCHEDULED #N].

every.description: Interval like '12h', '30m', '2h30m', '1d'. Min 60s. Required for add.

prompt.description: What the agent should do each time. Required for add.

model.description: Pin to a specific model (e.g. 'koompi-free') — optional, otherwise uses session default.

provider.description: Pin to a specific provider (e.g. 'kconsole') — optional.

skill.description: Pin to a specific skill — optional.

chat_id.description: Telegram chat to deliver results to. Defaults to current chat.

name: access_control
description: Manage whitelist. Actions: whitelist (add), revoke (remove), sethome (set home_chat), log (show last 20 changes). Every mutation auto-logged to brain/state/access_control.log — use action=log to find who was last added/removed instead of grepping session history.

target_id.description: User or chat ID. Required for whitelist/revoke/sethome.

name: send_file
description: Send a file from disk to the Telegram chat. Use when user asks to download/share a file.

name: tool_search
description:
Fetches schemas for tools marked as deferred so you can call them. Deferred tools appear by name (no schema) in the `## Deferred Tools` context block — until you load them via this tool, you cannot invoke them. Returns one `<function>{...}</function>` line per match.

Query forms:
  select:foo,bar  — fetch these exact tools by name
  ast python      — keyword search, ranked by relevance
  +kanban create  — require `kanban`, rank remaining terms

Loaded tool schemas persist for the rest of this session (cleared on /new).

query.description: Search query. `select:name1,name2` for exact, otherwise keywords.

max_results.description: Cap on number of schemas to return (default 5).

name: task
description:
Persistent, cross-session structured task list. SQLite-backed, survives /new and bot restarts. Use for genuinely multi-step work (3+ distinct sub-tasks) — skip for trivial single-step requests. Differs from `todo` (simpler, per-session checklist).

Actions:
- `create`: needs subject; optional description, active_form, metadata
- `list`: optional filter_status. Default lists open tasks.
- `get`: needs task_id, returns full details
- `update`: needs task_id + at least one field. Status workflow: pending → in_progress → completed (or failed/deleted)
- `delete`: needs task_id (soft-delete — sets status=deleted)

When you start a task, mark it in_progress IMMEDIATELY so the user sees progress. When you complete or fail it, update status before moving on. Never leave a task at in_progress after the turn ends.

subject.description: Imperative title (create / update). E.g. 'Fix auth bug'.

active_form.description: Present-continuous form shown while in_progress, e.g. 'Fixing auth bug'.

metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON object. On update, merged in (key=null deletes).
